text:
Mia Chen: @andrew heads up — Orchard Markets (acct: orchard-markets) reported invoice INV-2026-0412 shows a $1,250 overcharge. They say the month-to-month promo credit (ORCHARD50) didn't apply to Mar usage. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/invoices/INV-2026-0412

Andrew Patel: looking into it. do we have the promo ID applied on the invoice? cc @Jess

Jess Rivera: pulling usage logs + promo mappings now. quick note — multi-pool routing can sometimes skip promo tags if routing changes mid-billing-cycle.

Mia Chen: customer insists promo should've covered Mar 10–20. they were on Hosted + temporary Dedicated burst for a week.

Jess Rivera: found the gap — promo tag ORCHARD50 missing for 2026-03-14 -> 2026-03-21 for the orchard-markets project. routing fallback to Dedicated burst dropped the promo evaluation hook. Estimated manual credit = $1,250.00 (tokens + embeddings).

Jess Rivera: proposed action: create manual adjustment to INV-2026-0412 for -$1,250.00 as goodwill, and add a short-term fix to include promo evaluation on Dedicated bursts. filing a ticket and PR after approval.

Andrew Patel: approve manual goodwill credit of $1,250 for customer retention (we missed applying promo due to our routing edge case). approved :white_check_mark:

Billing Bot: ADJUSTMENT CREATED — ADJ-98421 by Jess Rivera. Invoice: INV-2026-0412. Amount: -$1,250.00. Journal ref: J-2026-319. Status: applied. Customer notified via billing-notify@orchard-markets.com.

Mia Chen: thank you — i'll loop in the CSM to confirm they've seen the notification and to offer a short-term credits timeline. :pray:

Jess Rivera: added note to internal incident board and opened PR to include promo evaluation in Dedicated burst routing (PR #1489). Will add a regression test in the billing-e2e suite.

Andrew Patel: please include a line in this week's billing ops retro so we can track recurrence.

Mia Chen: will do. closing on our side once CSM confirms receipt.

Billing Bot: Thread closed automatically by Billing Bot at 1775804625.
